note: v616: money shows in your currency. Any amount in a line the stage displays (the ticker, a tapped tweet line) gets an added note, for example "$36 (≈₦49,206)"; the line itself is never edited, an amount inside a quoted line keeps the quote and the note follows it, and «» lines are never touched. The currency comes from the viewer's browser locale (Intl), ?cur=XXX overrides it and ?cur=off turns it off. The rate comes from data/fx.json (open.er-api.com, with its date) or the page reads open.er-api.com itself when that file is older than 36 hours; with no rate nothing is shown, a rate is never invented.
